headline: GOLD SLIDES TO $4,508 — SECOND WEEKLY LOSS AS IRAN PEACE TALKS COLLAPSE
snippet: Gold fell to $4,508/oz on Sunday May 24 as hopes for a US-Iran deal evaporated after Iran's Supreme Leader ordered uranium to stay on Iranian soil. Elevated oil prices are fueling inflation fears and rate-hike expectations — a double headwind after gold's 16% correction from January's all-time high of $5,589.

headline: COPPER AT $6.35/LB — AI ELECTRIFICATION BOOM SUSTAINS NEAR-RECORD RALLY
snippet: Copper settled at $6.35/lb on May 22 after hitting an all-time COMEX high of $6.71 on May 13. Analysts say this rally is structurally unique: AI data centers, EV grid buildout, and the green energy transition are driving demand simultaneously while supply-side responses remain years away. Chile's Cochilco raised its 2026 price forecast to $5.55/lb.

headline: GOLDSEEK COT MAY 22: SILVER COMMERCIALS AT EXTREME SHORT — CONTRARIAN REVERSAL SIGNAL BUILDING
snippet: The May 22 Commitment of Traders report shows commercial traders holding historically extreme short positions in silver alongside elevated bearish gold positioning. These extremes have historically preceded sharp reversals to the upside. Retail speculators are watching for a final washout before the next leg higher in precious metals.

headline: URANIUM SPOT HOLDS $84.70 AS TERM PRICES PUSH INTO $86-90 BAND ON UTILITY CONTRACTING UPTICK
snippet: Uranium spot held at $84.70/lb on May 22, up 18% year-over-year, while long-term contract offer bands have shifted to $86-90/lb as producers indicate higher prices are needed to expand output. With tariff and policy uncertainty fading, utility contracting volumes are expected to recover materially in H2 2026 — still far below the 150M lb/yr theoretical replacement rate.

headline: GR SILVER DRILLS BEST RESULT IN COMPANY HISTORY: 8.25M AT 8,579 G/T AG AT SAN MARCIAL
snippet: GR Silver Mining (TSXV: GRSL) released its best-ever drill hole on May 19 at San Marcial, Mexico: 45.1m at 1,623 g/t Ag, including 8.25m at 8,579 g/t Ag in hole SMS26-04. Three rigs are active on a 20,000m step-out program. An updated resource estimate and PEA are targeted for H2 2026. The results confirm structural controls on high-grade silver within the SE Area of the deposit.

headline: TROILUS EXTENDS WEST RIM ZONE: 2.92 G/T AUEQ OVER 19M WITHIN 200M OF PLANNED PIT
snippet: Troilus Mining (TSX: TLG) expanded its West Rim Zone with 19m grading 2.92 g/t AuEQ — entirely outside the current resource and within 200m of the planned reserve pit in Quebec. Some of the strongest near-pit grade-thickness intercepts drilled to date at the project. The Northern Miner analysts cited the results as underscoring M&A potential for this near-construction copper-gold asset.

headline: JUGGERNAUT DRILLS GOLDEN TRIANGLE — 10,000M MAIDEN PROGRAM TESTS 22 KM² ELDORADO ZONE
snippet: Juggernaut Exploration (TSXV: JUGR) mobilized May 19 for its inaugural drill program at Big One in BC's Golden Triangle. The 10,000m program targets the Eldorado system, where 400+ mineralized veins up to 10m wide returned surface samples of up to 263.70 g/t AuEq. The company holds the property 100% and is fully funded for the program.

headline: AMERICAS GOLD & SILVER FINDS TEN NEW HIGH-GRADE VEINS AT GALENA — 4,896 G/T AG INTERCEPT
snippet: Americas Gold and Silver (TSX: USA) discovered ten new high-grade silver-copper-antimony veins at its Galena complex in Idaho, including 4,896 g/t Ag and 3.95% Cu over 1.3m. The company is launching its largest-ever 2026 exploration program to follow up the finds at one of the longest-producing primary silver mines in the United States.

headline: YEAR SIX: SILVER DEFICIT WIDENS 15% TO 46.3M OZ — 762M OZ DRAINED FROM ABOVE-GROUND STOCKS
snippet: The global silver market posted its sixth consecutive annual supply deficit in 2026, with the shortfall widening 15% to 46.3 million troy ounces per the Silver Institute's World Silver Survey. Since 2021, a cumulative 762 million ounces have been drawn from above-ground stocks. Industrial demand — solar, EVs, electronics — is outpacing flat mine supply with no quick fix in sight. Junior miners with polymetallic silver deposits are attracting accelerating capital.

headline: EQUINOX GOLD SWALLOWS ORLA IN $5.1B ALL-SHARE DEAL — CANADA'S NEW #2 SENIOR GOLD PRODUCER
snippet: Equinox Gold (TSX: EQX) and Orla Mining (TSX: OLA) agreed May 13 to merge via an all-share deal creating a US$18.5 billion company targeting 1M+ oz/yr gold production across six mines in Canada, the US, Mexico, and Nicaragua. Backed by Pierre Lassonde, the combined entity becomes Canada's second-largest gold producer. Shareholder votes expected July 2026, closing targeted for Q3.

headline: RECORD EARNINGS, DECADE-LOW VALUATIONS: GOLD MINERS STILL CHEAP AT 10.89X P/E
snippet: Despite 12 consecutive quarters of massive earnings growth — Agnico Eagle at $3,378/oz margins, Kinross up 235% year-over-year — GDX trades at just 10.89x trailing P/E, its lowest reading in at least a decade. Analysts argue gold stocks have dramatically underperformed their own profitability gains and that miners still offer 2-3x leverage to a gold price that has corrected to $4,500 from $5,589.

headline: CHINA NORTHERN RARE EARTH HIKES Q2 PRICE 44% — BIGGEST JUMP SINCE 2023 PRICING REFORM
snippet: China Northern Rare Earth Group set Q2 2026 concentrate prices at 38,804 yuan/tonne, up 44% from Q1 — the seventh consecutive quarterly increase and the largest single-quarter rise since China reformed its rare earth pricing mechanism in 2023. Beijing's export quotas could displace 13,000 tonnes of annual demand to non-Chinese sources. MP Materials and USA Rare Earth are the primary Western beneficiaries.
